recall.uz: Kitobga oshno bobo va buyuk shoir Alisher Navoiy haqidagi sheʼrni tinglab oʻqiymiz, hikmatli soʻzni yigʻamiz.
recall.ru: Слушаем стихотворение о дедушке-книголюбе и великом поэте Алишере Навои, собираем мудрое изречение.
recall.en: We read a poem about a book-loving grandfather and the great poet Alisher Navoiy, and assemble a wise saying.

prompt.ru: Послушай и читай, следя за текстом!
prompt.en: Listen and follow along as you read!

hint.en: What does grandfather do every evening?

explanation.uz: Sheʼr kitobsevar bobo va uning nabiralariga bergan nasihati haqida.
explanation.ru: Стихотворение о дедушке-книголюбе и его наставлении внукам.
explanation.en: The poem is about a book-loving grandfather and his advice to his grandchildren.

statement.uz: Bobo nabiralariga Navoiy sheʼrlaridan aytib beradi.
statement.en: Grandfather recites Navoiy's poems to his grandchildren.

why.uz: Sheʼrda «Navoiy sheʼridan yoddan bizga qaytar» deyilgan.
why.ru: В стихотворении сказано, что он читает стихи Навои наизусть.
why.en: The poem says he recites Navoiy's verses from memory.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

hint.en: What does grandfather recite from memory?

explanation.uz: Toʻgʻri: bobo Navoiy sheʼrlarini yoddan aytadi.
explanation.ru: Верно: дедушка читает стихи Навои наизусть.
explanation.en: True: grandfather recites Navoiy's poems by heart.

why.uz: Sheʼrda futbol haqida hech narsa aytilmagan.
why.ru: В стихотворении про футбол ничего не сказано.
why.en: The poem says nothing about football.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

hint.uz: Sheʼrda faqat kitob va sheʼr tilga olingan.
hint.ru: В стихотворении речь только о книге и стихах.
hint.en: The poem only mentions books and poems.

props.phrase: Oz-oz oʻrganib dono boʻlur, qatra-qatra yigʻilib daryo boʻlur.

meaning.uz: Bilim oz-ozdan orttiriladi — sabr bilan katta natijaga erishiladi.
meaning.ru: Знания копятся понемногу — терпение приводит к большому результату.
meaning.en: Knowledge grows little by little — patience brings great results.

prompt.uz: Soʻzlarni kichikdan kattaga bosib, Navoiyning hikmatli soʻzini oʻqing!
prompt.ru: Нажимай слова от маленького к большому и прочитай мудрое изречение Навои!
prompt.en: Tap the words smallest to largest to read Navoiy's wise saying!

explanation.uz: «Oz-oz oʻrganib dono boʻlur, qatra-qatra yigʻilib daryo boʻlur» — Alisher Navoiy.
explanation.ru: «Учась понемногу, станешь мудрым; по капле собираясь, станешь рекой» — Навои.
explanation.en: “Learning little by little you grow wise; gathering drop by drop you become a river” — Navoiy.

prompt.en: Match each word to its meaning!

explanation.uz: mangu = abadiy; dong taratdi = mashhur boʻldi; ezgulik = yaxshilik.
explanation.ru: mangu = вечный; dong taratdi = прославился; ezgulik = добро.
explanation.en: mangu = eternal; dong taratdi = became famous; ezgulik = goodness.

prompt.ru: Нажми слова, близкие по значению к «olam»!
prompt.en: Tap the words that mean the same as “olam” (world)!

hint.en: Olam means the whole world, the universe.

explanation.uz: olam = dunyo = koinot. Daftar va poyabzal boshqa maʼnoda.
explanation.ru: olam = мир = вселенная. Тетрадь и обувь — о другом.
explanation.en: olam = world = universe. Notebook and shoes are unrelated.

prompt.ru: К чему дедушка призывает детей в стихотворении?
prompt.en: What does grandfather call the children to do?

explanation.uz: Bobo bolalarni kitob oʻqishga, bilim olishga chaqiradi.
explanation.ru: Дедушка призывает детей читать и получать знания.
explanation.en: Grandfather calls the children to read and gain knowledge.

openEnd.uz: Alisher Navoiy haqida yana nimalarni bilasan? Bir gap ayt.
openEnd.ru: Что ещё ты знаешь об Алишере Навои? Скажи одно предложение.
openEnd.en: What else do you know about Alisher Navoiy? Say one sentence.

prompt.en: Build the sentence from the words!

explanation.en: “A book is the lamp of the mind”: it lights up the mind.

clue.uz: Qaysi biri kitob dunyosiga aloqador emas?
clue.ru: Что не связано с миром книг?
clue.en: Which one doesn't belong to the world of books?

hint.uz: Uchtasi oʻqish-yozuvga oid, biri esa kiyim.
hint.ru: Три связаны с чтением, одно — обувь.
hint.en: Three relate to reading, one is footwear.

explanation.uz: Poyafzal — kiyim; kitob, sheʼr, daftar esa oʻqish-yozuvga oid.
explanation.ru: Обувь лишняя; книга, стих, тетрадь — про чтение и письмо.
explanation.en: Footwear is the odd one; book, poem, notebook relate to reading and writing.

prompt.en: Build the word from the syllables!
